_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "In January 2025, I started building a dedicated store for a new set of Framer templates. That's when I hit my first roadblock. I had to wait about a week for Lemon Squeezy to approve my account. During that time, I couldn't launch or sell anything. To avoid holding off my release, I switched to Gumroad so I could start selling right away. Gumroad worked well. It was easy to set up, and I liked the clean interface. But the fees felt a bit high. So once my Lemon Squeezy store was approved, I moved everything back over."
